epic.title: Trip semantics: HARD must refuse the verbs that BEGIN work, not the verb that writes the handoff
epic.intent_and_why: Issue #467 in epic #418 wave 4. The shipped context governor refuses `advance` at HARD. But `advance --why` is the ONLY writer of the why-trail, and that --why IS the cold-start DIGEST a successor reads. So the governor refuses the one verb that writes the handoff, which is #431. Moving HARD's enforcement to the verbs that BEGIN work (`start`, `reopen` -- not `resume`, which returns an agent to a gate it is already mid-way through) fixes it at zero new CLI surface, which is also the shape #424 is blocked on.

definition_of_done: The #431 deadlock is reproduced as a genuine RED at unmodified HEAD before any fix is written.
HARD refuses the verbs that begin work and permits `advance --why`, so a tripping agent can write its handoff.
`advance --mechanical` is refused at/over hard and `why_exempt` is suspended there, so the fix cannot be walked around.
The engine emits a concrete why-id rather than a `<why-id>` placeholder that no-ops when followed literally.
DC6's observable is 'did anyone BEGIN work while over the line', never 'did a handoff artifact appear'.
The full suite holds at its baseline: 1793 passed, 2 skipped, 683 subtests, real exit 0.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: No check may be satisfiable by construction. Epic #418's central defect is a check that cannot fail; a manufactured RED is that defect wearing the costume of evidence.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A RED reproduced at unmodified HEAD that an independent reader has actively tried to break, plus the shipped engine and gauge suites at baseline.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded issue, five gates, inside epic #418 wave 4.

hard_constraints: The RED must be observable at UNMODIFIED HEAD: `git diff --stat -- scripts tests` empty, and `main...HEAD` empty.
No absence is evidence -- a silent governor and a governor with headroom are indistinguishable, so every gate that depends on a reading must prove the reading was READ.

The repro is disposable and leaves no residue; it is not promoted to a regression test (the deadlock is a property of a refusal path being deleted, so it is unreproducible by construction afterwards).
Never run pytest via `py` (#454 gives a false HARNESS ERROR); use `FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests`.
A piped command's `$?` is the PIPE's exit code; use `${PIPESTATUS[0]}` or redirect and read separately.
No writes under `.agent-work/epic-418-redux/**` (the Admiral's) and none to `.claude/settings.json` (#458).
fixed_decisions: The plan frozen at `plan` is executed, not re-planned; changes go through the engine's `amend`/`reopen`, never by hand-editing execute.json.
HARD guards the verbs that BEGIN work; `resume` is explicitly NOT guarded.

current_wave.objective: Reproduce #431 as a genuine RED at unmodified HEAD, then move HARD's enforcement off `advance` and onto the verbs that begin work.
exit_criteria: g1 closed: the RED is reproduced and an independent reviewer has tried to break it and failed.
g2-g4 closed: the fix lands, the mechanical walkaround is closed, and the concrete why-id is emitted.

issues.title: Trip semantics -- HARD must not refuse the verb that writes the handoff
issues.desired_outcome: A tripping agent at/over HARD can run `advance --why` to write its DIGEST, and is refused only when it tries to BEGIN new work.
issues.useful_now: #424 is blocked on this shape, and every Commander handoff in this epic currently depends on a governor that refuses the handoff-writing verb.
issues.appetite: Five gates inside one issue: reproduce the RED, move the guard, close the mechanical walkaround, emit the concrete why-id, and hold the suite at baseline.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A RED at unmodified HEAD that flips GREEN under the fix and RED again if reverted; falsified if any assertion passes on BOTH sides of the fix while being presented as #431 evidence.
issues.implementation_latitude: Internals of the guard are free; the CLI surface must not grow.
hard_constraints_no_gos: No new CLI verbs or flags.
The repro must not become a regression test.
local_unknowns: Whether #431 is a mechanical lock or an instruction-conformance defect -- SETTLED at g1, see D2.
issues.hitl_reason: The acceptance evidence is a governor RED that must be judged genuine rather than manufactured, and epic #418's central defect is a check that cannot fail. That judgement is a human/Admiral call, not a machine check -- and it has already produced two decisions this run that exceeded Commander latitude: whether ACCEPT WITH FINDINGS satisfies a postcondition matching the literal string APPROVE, and whether committed disposable evidence should be untracked.

wave_forecast.outcome: #424 unblocks once the trip-semantics shape is settled
wave_forecast.why_likely: #424 was blocked specifically on whether the fix needed new CLI surface; g1's evidence says it does not.
entry_conditions: #467 lands and holds the suite at baseline

discrepancies.signal: g1-integrate's postcondition c3 matches the literal verdict string APPROVE, but the reviewer handoff frozen at the g1 seam prescribes the vocabulary ACCEPT / ACCEPT WITH FINDINGS / REJECT and calls ACCEPT WITH FINDINGS the healthy outcome. The reviewer obeyed the handoff, so c3 cannot pass as written.
discrepancies.affects: g1-integrate closure only; the RED itself is unaffected and verified genuine.
discrepancies.evidence: execute.json g1-integrate c3 = {kind: artifact, evidence_type: review-result, match: {verdict: APPROVE}}; crew-handoffs/g1-reviewer-handoff.md prescribes the other three-value vocabulary; crew-handoffs/g1-reviewer-result.md returns ACCEPT WITH FINDINGS with 0 blocking findings.
discrepancies.reason: Two frozen artifacts authored one step apart by the same agent disagree on a free-text verdict string, and nothing checks that they agree. Resolving it by attaching a second artifact reading APPROVE would be fabricated evidence, so it is floated to the Admiral rather than resolved in-gate.

discrepancies.signal: #431 is an instruction-conformance defect, not a mechanical deadlock: the post-attach `advance` SUCCEEDS and writes a fresh DIGEST. The engine permits the advance while, in the same breath, telling the agent not to run it.
discrepancies.affects: What g2-g4 must measure the fix against. A fix verified as 'the advance is no longer blocked' would be verifying something that was never blocked.
discrepancies.evidence: Reviewer PROBE 2, written specifically to test this. The repro narrated the property in prose ('a further advance would be permitted') rather than asserting it -- reviewer finding N3.
discrepancies.reason: This is the plan's most load-bearing structural assumption and it was carried as narration, not as an assertion. It survived, but the framing must be corrected before g2-g4 design their evidence.

discrepancies.signal: A shipped check that cannot PASS: REVIEW_SURVEY.template.json ships r6-fowler's c1 command containing a literal `<fowler-pass-record-path>`, which a POSIX shell reads as a redirect from a nonexistent file. No engine verb can fill it -- `amend` is gated-only, `attest` refuses engine-checked conditions -- so a force-waive is the only exit.
discrepancies.affects: Epic #418's framing. It has been hunting checks that cannot FAIL; this is the mirror case, and D1 is a second instance in this run's own frozen plan.
discrepancies.evidence: Reviewer workflow feedback W1; the reviewer force-waived with the real command and its real exit 0 recorded in the waiver, and the Fowler pass itself genuinely passed.
discrepancies.reason: A real defect in a shipped template, outside #467's done-conditions. Recorded, not filed -- this run has no filing authority.

discrepancies.signal: The commit-at-the-seam handoff protocol swept the deliberately-disposable repro into permanent history. All 29 files under red-repro/ entered tracking in 62f564c7, the predecessor Commander's seam-commit at its trip -- not through any `git add` by the implementer, whose 'not git added' claim was true when written.
discrepancies.affects: decision:red-leaves-no-residue, and the trip protocol generally. Every repro re-run now dirties 25 tracked files; the Commander's own re-run at g1-integrate did exactly that.
discrepancies.evidence: `git ls-files -- .../red-repro | wc -l` = 29; `git check-ignore` exit 1; `git log --diff-filter=A -- .../red-repro/repro_431.py` = 62f564c7; `git show --stat 62f564c7 -- .../red-repro` = 29 files changed, 1953 insertions; `git diff --name-only -- .../red-repro | wc -l` = 25 after the Commander's re-run.
discrepancies.reason: Two doctrines are in direct tension -- commit-at-the-seam (which makes a trip lossless) and leaves-no-residue (which keeps disposable evidence disposable) -- and nothing currently notices. The implementer handoff even carried a Deliverable Path Check saying not to commit it; a Commander committing at a seam does not consult it. The remedy is outside the frozen plan, so it was floated, not done.

discrepancies.signal: The spine's cold-start projection is stale by construction for any trip that happens mid-`execute`. `advance` is the only writer of the why-trail and the spine's `execute` step spans all 16 gates, so a Commander tripping mid-step cannot update the spine's DIGEST at all.
discrepancies.affects: DC5. The spine's `current` told this Commander to drive execute.json from `e0-context`, a gate complete and committed two agents earlier.
discrepancies.evidence: spine.json current still carries the w-4 DIGEST written two agents ago; execute.json current was accurate. RESUME_OBSERVATION.md, second-resume section.
discrepancies.reason: This is the ordinary case, not an edge case, since `execute` is where nearly all the time goes. Neither the predecessor nor this Commander amended the frozen plan to route around it. It cost nothing here only because the Admiral supplied a two-line correction by hand -- which is the remaining manual step in the round trip.

discrepancies.signal: The gauge misattribution at a handoff is real but narrower than RESUME_OBSERVATION.md's first section records. It does NOT make the round trip loop permanently.
discrepancies.affects: DC5. The predecessor recorded that a resumed Commander reads as over the line the instant it starts and the round trip therefore cannot close.
discrepancies.evidence: On arrival, execute.json current printed `CONTEXT 15% (>= hard)` against a gauge stamped 10:45:36Z that was not this Commander's. The first mutating command rewrote it to fill_fraction 0.051788 at 10:46:57Z and the band released unaided; nothing was waived. Difference from the predecessor's run: both earlier agents had STOPPED before this one started, so nothing contended.
discrepancies.reason: Partially falsified as stated. The mechanism (many agent keys, one spine-derived gauge path, last writer wins) is real, but it bites only while the tripped predecessor is still taking tool calls -- which is exactly what 'commit at the seam, hand off, and go idle' already forbids. Two runs, one variable changed, opposite outcomes: a cleaner attribution than either run alone. The lease-aware-writer fix would close even the overlap window.

discrepancies.signal: `why_ref=<why-id>` copy-pasted literally from the engine's own refusal attaches with exit 0 and does NOT release HARD -- a silent no-op on the exact command the engine prints at the agent. The real id is not recoverable from `current` or from the refusal text.
discrepancies.affects: Nothing new -- g2(d) already plans the fix (emit the concrete why-id).
discrepancies.evidence: Found by the g1 implementer; independently corroborated by reviewer PROBE 3 (attach exit 0, following advance still refused) and PROBE 4 (no `w-N` appears in current or in the refusal); independently corroborated a third time by TRIP_OBSERVATION.md item 4.
discrepancies.reason: Already owned by a planned gate; recorded because it now has three independent confirmations and because the shape -- an engine printing a command that fails silently when followed literally -- is worth checking wherever else the engine prints commands.
